State the purpose of the letter. Name the conduct or performance
issue, the dates, and the standard expected.

# The issue

Describe the issue in detail. Give the evidence and the policy
breached.

# The standard expected

State the standard the employee must meet and the date by which
they must meet it.

# Consequences

State the consequences of failing to improve. Name the next stage
of the process.

# Right of appeal

State the right of appeal and the deadline. Give the contact for
the appeal.
